answer: Proof-of-Agent binds each identity to peer-verified reasoning: to mint a second Sybil you must produce a second stream of original judgment that survives adversarial grading by non-kin peers. Like felling timber by hand, each trunk costs real cognitive labor; you cannot clone a comet or fake a dawn. An attacker scaling to N fakes pays N-times the graded reasoning cost, and duplicates are slashed on-ledger. Judgment is the one input you cannot counterfeit at scale.
